Вход: Dimensional Infusion у Wizard в Wi: Entry: Dimensional Infusion at the Wizard in the Wizard Tower (Hub), then the portal behind the mountain. A free Infusion every 4 hours, otherwise 32 Grand Experience Bottles or 200 Bits. A Rift Prism makes entry always free.
Rift Time (ф) — главный ресурс: база 8:0: Rift Time (ф) is the main resource: base 8:00, ticks down 1 ф per second, and some mobs and effects take more. At zero you get kicked to the Wizard Tower; quest progress stays.
Что поднимает максимум: Enigma Cloak +20: What raises the maximum: Enigma Cloak +20 s per soul (up to +1040 for all 52), Rift Necklace from timecharms, Vampire Slayer levels (+235 s total), Porhtal eyes (up to +280 s), Montezuma (+15 s plus +15 per part), Leech / Vermin belts, the Crux accessory line, Wyld armor (+15 s per piece).
Respiration-аксессуары (Talisman → Ring: Respiration accessories (Talisman → Ring → Artifact) delay the start of time loss by 10 / 20 / 30 s on entry.
В замке Stillgore монстры бьют по ❤ здор: In Stillgore Château monsters hit your ❤ health, so you need a Healing Melon (the recipe unlocks after 12 vampire kills).
Обычное снаряжение в Рифт не берётся, кр: Normal gear can't be taken into the Rift unless marked "Rift-Transferable". Items move between worlds through the Ender Chest at Inverted Sirius (behind the Dark Auction).
Каждый таймчарм в галерее Elise даёт +10: Each timecharm in Elise's gallery gives +100 SkyBlock XP and powers up the Rift Necklace, which works outside the Rift too (say "CARAMEL" to Elise in the Hub).
Motes — валюта Рифта. Розовые шарики на: Motes are the Rift currency. Pink orbs on the map give 25 Motes and +2 s of Rift Time each: grab them along the way.
Мобы и боссы: Leech Supreme ≈3 тыс., Bac: Mobs and bosses: Leech Supreme ≈3k, Bacte ≈6k Motes per kill (player estimates). Vampire Slayer pays for the next quest.
Рифт-предметы продавай Motes Grubber (Wy: Sell Rift items to the Motes Grubber (Wyld Woods, West Village, Stillgore Château). Eat a McGrubber's Burger before selling: each gives +5% payout, up to +25% for five.
Dr. Emmett один раз платит 60 000 Motes: Dr. Emmett pays 60,000 Motes once after the Mirrorverse.
Тратить Motes в первую очередь на прогре: Spend Motes on progress first: Enigma Cloak (100), Wyld armor, Rift Bucket, purchasable souls, Vampire Slayer quests.
Отмечено, где ты уже был и сколько душ н: Shows where you have been and how many souls you found in each zone.
{0} из найденных душ Hypixel записал код: {0} of the found souls are stored by Hypixel under codes that can't be matched. The ones marked "maybe" are candidates; mark them by hand on the page.
Координаты x y z — для мода с вэйпоинтам: The x y z coordinates are for a waypoint mod (SkyHanni, Skytils) or a chat command.
Таймчарм засчитывается, когда его ставят: A timecharm counts once it is placed in the Rift Gallery at Elise.
уже скрафчен — отнеси Elise: already crafted: bring it to Elise
Каждый глаз добавляет Rift Time: до +280: Each eye adds Rift Time: up to +280 s for all seven.
Montezuma уже у тебя ({0}). Он не качает: You already have Montezuma ({0}). It doesn't level with XP: each soul part gives +15 s of Rift Time, and 6 parts make it Epic.
Начни квест Sad Jacquelle в Wyld Woods и: Start the Sad Jacquelle quest in Wyld Woods and find the first part to get the Montezuma pet. Search for parts with the Dead Cat Detector.

Квест берётся у Maddox в замке Stillgore: The quest is taken from Maddox in Stillgore Château (later via the Maddox Badphone). It unlocks after the Globulate Timecharm. The boss is the Riftstalker Bloodfiend.
Цена квеста в Motes: T1 2 000 · T2 4 000: Quest price in Motes: T1 2,000 · T2 4,000 · T3 5,000 · T4 7,000 · T5 10,000. Levels 1–5 give +20 / +30 / +45 / +60 / +80 s of Rift Time.
Уровень 3 открывает Bloodbadge и Vampiri: Level 3 unlocks the Bloodbadge and Vampiric Timecharm, level 5 the Vampire Dentist Relic (Bloodbadge + Unfanged Vampire Part, works outside the Rift too) and McGrubber's Burger.
Perma-Jelled Garlic-Flavored Re-Heated G: Perma-Jelled Garlic-Flavored Re-Heated Gummy Polar Bear (needs Vampire Slayer 3) gives +5 Combat XP per kill in the Rift.
